## 🔴 High Impact

### NFLX — Netflix | **Bearish**
Netflix sank **5–7%** yesterday (Oct 21) and the selloff continues today. The company issued weak Q4 2026 guidance, slashed its ad revenue projections, and announced **1,000 layoffs**. Multiple analysts cut price targets. The stock is at a **two-year low**. Key concern: slowing subscriber growth and underperforming advertising tier are raising structural questions about the business model.

### BABA — Alibaba | **Bearish**
Alibaba shares are down **~6%** today — their **steepest single-day drop in two months** — after China's regulators announced a sweeping **e-commerce quality crackdown**, pressing platforms to meet higher product standards. This is fresh regulatory headwind on top of ongoing macroeconomic pressure in China. JD.com also sliding in sympathy.
- Sources: [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-22/alibaba-shares-post-steepest-drop-in-two-months-on-china-curbs) · [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/alibaba-shares-post-steepest-drop-043240480.html) · [Investing.com](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/alibaba-jd-shares-slide-on-more-chinese-regulatory-scrutiny-4895150)

### TSLA — Tesla | **Mixed**
Tesla reported **Q3 2026 earnings** on Oct 21. **EPS beat** consensus; **margins rebounded** sequentially and **free cash flow surprised** to the upside — positive signals. However, **revenue came in flat** (slight miss vs. estimates), **net profit still fell** year-over-year, and **capex missed** by ~$3.2B as AI infrastructure spending accelerated beyond projections. The stock **slipped after hours** on the revenue miss and rising capex. Market reaction today will be key.
- Sources: [Investing.com earnings call](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-tesla-beats-q3-2026-estimates-as-stock-slips-after-hours-93CH-4964365) · [Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/10/21/tesla-tsla-q3-2026-financial-results/) · [Shattered.io](https://shattered.io/tesla-q3-2026-capex-misses-3-2-billion-beat/)
